# Mike Jackson

Mike Jackson is the current Connétable of [St Brelade](https://flow.je/elections/st-brelade) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2005.

Mike Jackson has participated in 6 elections since 2002:

- [**2005 St Brelade Connétable Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mike-jackson#e26)

  Elected as Connétable of St Brelade with 70.4% of the vote.
- [**2008 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mike-jackson#e11)

  Elected as Connétable of St Brelade unopposed.
- [**2011 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mike-jackson#e14)

  Not elected.
- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mike-jackson#e20)

  Not elected.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/michael-jackson/)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=duUkBEGKPPs)
- [**2018 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mike-jackson#e43)

  Elected as Connétable of St Brelade unopposed.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/michael-jackson-2/)
- [**2022 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mike-jackson#e49)

  Elected as Connétable of St Brelade.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/mike-jackson-2/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IPAljsLbhps)
  - [2022 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20230208123922/https://mikejackson.je/#manifesto)

Mike Jackson has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Connétables Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [St Brelade](https://flow.je/elections/st-brelade). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/04/contested-constable-election-set-to-be-held-in-western-parish/)\]

Links for Mike Jackson:

- Twitter : [@mikejackson1952](https://twitter.com/mikejackson1952)

## Election History

### 2005 St Brelade Connétable Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St Brelade](https://flow.je/elections/st-brelade) (1 seat), 9th November 2005.

**Mike Jackson was elected as Connétable of St Brelade in 2005**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Mike Jackson** |  | 1,466 | 70.4% |
| 2 | [Steve Pallett](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/steve-pallett) |  | 615 | 29.6% |
| 3 | ~~[Sarah Ferguson](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sarah-ferguson)~~ |  | Withdrew |  |

2,081 votes

Unknown registered voters
